features: Fixed a crash that occurred when opening the edit page of a registered supplier invoice: some data (suppliers, budget, reserve funds) required from page load was missing.
Fixed an error that occurred when opening the list, detail, or edit page of an already reversed supplier invoice.

Editing a non-editable supplier invoice (reversed, from a closed accounting year, carried over, with contingent items, pending budget-overrun approval, or on an extraordinary installment plan) now always shows a clear message instead of silently failing.
Added display of warning messages on the invoice detail page, which previously showed none.

Fixed an issue where sending email from the admin panel's SMTP configuration could silently fail on some hosting providers due to an invalid EHLO hostname; also fixed the SSL encryption option, which previously had no effect.
